title: Nature’s job-satisfaction survey highlights the changing geography of science
title_zh: 《自然》工作满意度调查显示科学地理版图的变迁
abstract: A higher proportion of scientists in China and India report feeling optimistic about the future than in the United States and several European countries.
abstract_zh: 相比美国和几个欧洲国家，中国和印度的科学家中感到对未来持乐观态度的比例更高。
